scope: One opt-in INTIN4 active-high Fixed level route to physical Local APIC ID 0 with atomic TMR, Remote IRR and EOI retrigger
sources: Intel 82093AA I/O APIC document 290566-001, preliminary release, §3.2.4
review: Independent gpt-6.1-sol/high review found a P2 independent-reset regression; fix and regression tests were confirmed in repeat review with no remaining findings.

checks.layout_check: only the pre-existing unmapped root smoke/ directory (ISSUE-056)

limitations: only one physical INTIN4 route to Local APIC ID 0 is supported
only active-high Fixed delivery and selected Dword registers are implemented
guest CPU interrupt/handler delivery, IDT/IF, APIC bus behavior, default board wiring, other IOAPIC routes and Linux discovery remain unimplemented
parent S4-26 and Stage 4 remain open
